37: // InternalIssuer is a certificate issuer that generates
38: // certificates internally using a locally-configured
39: // CA which can be customized using the `pki` app.
40: type InternalIssuer struct {
41: 	// The ID of the CA to use for signing. The default
42: 	// CA ID is "local". The CA can be configured with the
43: 	// `pki` app.
44: 	CA string `json:"ca,omitempty"`
45: 
46: 	// The validity period of certificates.
47: 	Lifetime caddy.Duration `json:"lifetime,omitempty"`
48: 
49: 	// If true, the root will be the issuer instead of
50: 	// the intermediate. This is NOT recommended and should
51: 	// only be used when devices/clients do not properly
52: 	// validate certificate chains.
53: 	SignWithRoot bool `json:"sign_with_root,omitempty"`
54: 
55: 	ca     *caddypki.CA
56: 	logger *zap.Logger
57: }

59: // CaddyModule returns the Caddy module information.
60: func (InternalIssuer) CaddyModule() caddy.ModuleInfo {
61: 	return caddy.ModuleInfo{

63: 		New: func() caddy.Module { return new(InternalIssuer) },
64: 	}
65: }

67: // Provision sets up the issuer.
68: func (iss *InternalIssuer) Provision(ctx caddy.Context) error {
69: 	iss.logger = ctx.Logger()
70: 
71: 	// set some defaults
72: 	if iss.CA == "" {
73: 		iss.CA = caddypki.DefaultCAID
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	// get a reference to the configured CA
77: 	appModule, err := ctx.App("pki")
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		return err
80: 	}
81: 	pkiApp := appModule.(*caddypki.PKI)
82: 	ca, err := pkiApp.GetCA(ctx, iss.CA)
83: 	if err != nil {
84: 		return err
85: 	}
86: 	iss.ca = ca
87: 
88: 	// set any other default values
89: 	if iss.Lifetime == 0 {
90: 		iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(defaultInternalCertLifetime)
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	return nil
94: }

97: // configured CA endpoint.
98: func (iss InternalIssuer) IssuerKey() string {
99: 	return iss.ca.ID
100: }

102: // Issue issues a certificate to satisfy the CSR.
103: func (iss InternalIssuer) Issue(ctx context.Context, csr *x509.CertificateRequest) (*certmagic.IssuedCertificate, error) {
104: 	// prepare the signing authority
105: 	authCfg := caddypki.AuthorityConfig{
106: 		SignWithRoot: iss.SignWithRoot,
107: 	}
108: 	auth, err := iss.ca.NewAuthority(authCfg)
109: 	if err != nil {
110: 		return nil, err
111: 	}
112: 
113: 	// get the cert (public key) that will be used for signing
114: 	var issuerCert *x509.Certificate
115: 	if iss.SignWithRoot {
116: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.RootCertificate()
117: 	} else {
118: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.IntermediateCertificate()
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	// ensure issued certificate does not expire later than its issuer
122: 	lifetime := time.Duration(iss.Lifetime)
123: 	if time.Now().Add(lifetime).After(issuerCert.NotAfter) {
124: 		lifetime = time.Until(issuerCert.NotAfter)
125: 		iss.logger.Warn("cert lifetime would exceed issuer NotAfter, clamping lifetime",
126: 			zap.Duration("orig_lifetime", time.Duration(iss.Lifetime)),
127: 			zap.Duration("lifetime", lifetime),
128: 			zap.Time("not_after", issuerCert.NotAfter),
129: 		)
130: 	}
131: 
132: 	certChain, err := auth.SignWithContext(ctx, csr, provisioner.SignOptions{}, customCertLifetime(caddy.Duration(lifetime)))
133: 	if err != nil {
134: 		return nil, err
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
138: 	for _, cert := range certChain {
139: 		err := pem.Encode(&buf, &pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: cert.Raw})
140: 		if err != nil {
141: 			return nil, err
142: 		}
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	return &certmagic.IssuedCertificate{
146: 		Certificate: buf.Bytes(),
147: 	}, nil
148: }

150: // UnmarshalCaddyfile deserializes Caddyfile tokens into iss.
151: //
152: //	... internal {
153: //	    ca       <name>
154: //	    lifetime <duration>
155: //	    sign_with_root
156: //	}
157: func (iss *InternalIssuer) UnmarshalCaddyfile(d *caddyfile.Dispenser) error {
158: 	d.Next() // consume issuer name
159: 	for d.NextBlock(0) {
160: 		switch d.Val() {
161: 		case "ca":
162: 			if !d.AllArgs(&iss.CA) {
163: 				return d.ArgErr()
164: 			}
165: 
166: 		case "lifetime":
167: 			if !d.NextArg() {
168: 				return d.ArgErr()
169: 			}
170: 			dur, err := caddy.ParseDuration(d.Val())
171: 			if err != nil {
172: 				return err
173: 			}
174: 			iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(dur)
175: 
176: 		case "sign_with_root":
177: 			if d.NextArg() {
178: 				return d.ArgErr()
179: 			}
180: 			iss.SignWithRoot = true
181: 		}
182: 	}
183: 	return nil
184: }

186: // customCertLifetime allows us to customize certificates that are issued
187: // by Smallstep libs, particularly the NotBefore & NotAfter dates.
188: type customCertLifetime time.Duration
189: 
190: func (d customCertLifetime) Modify(cert *x509.Certificate, _ provisioner.SignOptions) error {
191: 	cert.NotBefore = time.Now()
192: 	cert.NotAfter = cert.NotBefore.Add(time.Duration(d))
193: 	return nil
194: }
195: 
196: const defaultInternalCertLifetime = 12 * time.Hour

201: 	_ certmagic.Issuer                = (*InternalIssuer)(nil)
202: 	_ provisioner.CertificateModifier = (*customCertLifetime)(nil)

121: // Provision sets up the ACME server handler.
122: func (ash *Handler) Provision(ctx caddy.Context) error {
123: 	ash.ctx = ctx
124: 	ash.logger = ctx.Logger()
125: 
126: 	// set some defaults
127: 	if ash.CA == "" {
128: 		ash.CA = caddypki.DefaultCAID
129: 	}
130: 	if ash.PathPrefix == "" {
131: 		ash.PathPrefix = defaultPathPrefix
132: 	}
133: 	if ash.Lifetime == 0 {
134: 		ash.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(12 * time.Hour)
135: 	}
136: 	if len(ash.Challenges) > 0 {
137: 		if err := ash.Challenges.validate(); err != nil {
138: 			return err
139: 		}
140: 	}
141: 
142: 	// get a reference to the configured CA
143: 	appModule, err := ctx.App("pki")
144: 	if err != nil {
145: 		return err
146: 	}
147: 	pkiApp := appModule.(*caddypki.PKI)
148: 	ca, err := pkiApp.GetCA(ctx, ash.CA)
149: 	if err != nil {
150: 		return err
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	// make sure leaf cert lifetime is less than the intermediate cert lifetime. this check only
154: 	// applies for caddy-managed intermediate certificates
155: 	if ca.Intermediate == nil && ash.Lifetime >= ca.IntermediateLifetime {
156: 		return fmt.Errorf("certificate lifetime (%s) should be less than intermediate certificate lifetime (%s)", time.Duration(ash.Lifetime), time.Duration(ca.IntermediateLifetime))
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	database, err := ash.openDatabase()
160: 	if err != nil {
161: 		return err
162: 	}
163: 
164: 	authorityConfig := caddypki.AuthorityConfig{
165: 		SignWithRoot: ash.SignWithRoot,
166: 		AuthConfig: &authority.AuthConfig{
167: 			Provisioners: provisioner.List{
168: 				&provisioner.ACME{
169: 					Name:       ash.CA,
170: 					Challenges: ash.Challenges.toSmallstepType(),
171: 					Options: &provisioner.Options{
172: 						X509: ash.Policy.normalizeRules(),
173: 					},
174: 					Type: provisioner.TypeACME.String(),
175: 					Claims: &provisioner.Claims{
176: 						MinTLSDur:     &provisioner.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
177: 						MaxTLSDur:     &provisioner.Duration{Duration: 24 * time.Hour * 365},
178: 						DefaultTLSDur: &provisioner.Duration{Duration: time.Duration(ash.Lifetime)},
179: 					},
180: 				},
181: 			},
182: 		},
183: 		DB: database,
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	ash.acmeAuth, err = ca.NewAuthority(authorityConfig)
187: 	if err != nil {
188: 		return err
189: 	}
190: 
191: 	ash.acmeDB, err = acmeNoSQL.New(ash.acmeAuth.GetDatabase().(nosql.DB))

197: 	if err != nil {

207: 	r := chi.NewRouter()
208: 	r.Route(ash.PathPrefix, func(r chi.Router) {
209: 		api.Route(r)
210: 	})
211: 	ash.acmeEndpoints = r
212: 
213: 	return nil
214: }

280: // makeClient creates an ACME client which will use a custom
281: // resolver instead of net.DefaultResolver.
282: func (ash Handler) makeClient() (acme.Client, error) {
283: 	for _, v := range ash.Resolvers {
284: 		addr, err := caddy.ParseNetworkAddressWithDefaults(v, "udp", 53)
285: 		if err != nil {
286: 			return nil, err
287: 		}
288: 		if addr.PortRangeSize() != 1 {
289: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolver address must have exactly one address; cannot call %v", addr)
290: 		}
291: 		ash.resolvers = append(ash.resolvers, addr)
292: 	}
293: 
294: 	var resolver *net.Resolver
295: 	if len(ash.resolvers) != 0 {
296: 		dialer := &net.Dialer{
297: 			Timeout: 2 * time.Second,
298: 		}
299: 		resolver = &net.Resolver{
300: 			PreferGo: true,
301: 			Dial: func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
302: 				//nolint:gosec
303: 				addr := ash.resolvers[weakrand.Intn(len(ash.resolvers))]
304: 				return dialer.DialContext(ctx, addr.Network, addr.JoinHostPort(0))
305: 			},
306: 		}
307: 	} else {
308: 		resolver = net.DefaultResolver
309: 	}
310: 
311: 	return resolverClient{
312: 		Client:   acme.NewClient(),
313: 		resolver: resolver,
314: 		ctx:      ash.ctx,
315: 	}, nil
316: }

I added a `sign_with_root` case to `parseACMEServer` (modules/caddypki/acmeserver/caddyfile.go:156) that rejects args and sets `Handler.SignWithRoot`, and documented it in the directive's usage comment. Verified with the `acme_server_sign_with_root` and `tls_internal_options` adapt tests plus the full `caddytest` and `caddypki`/`caddytls` suites.
